root_cause_WDICT5_confirmed.what_was_wrong: v2's predicate obtained a candidate's word wp via PreImagesRepresentative (GAP's own free-group epimorphism, APPEND/standard left-to-right convention) but fed wp into EvalWordInQ, which uses PREPEND convention (val := g^pow * val, reversed order). EvalWordInQ(wp) != p in general -- theta/tau were evaluated on a DIFFERENT group element than the one the row claimed to test, in the direction that manufactures false DROPs.
root_cause_WDICT5_confirmed.K2_reproduced_the_bug_without_detecting_: acknowledged: the v2 K2 calibration (raw48/valid2) happened to reproduce the expected numbers WHILE carrying this defect, because K2's window has c_in_K2=true, where theta/tau word-level substitution IS mathematically safe regardless of convention mismatch in a specific narrow sense -- but the coordinator's point stands: calibration matching the expected numbers is NOT proof of implementation correctness, and this repair does not repeat that reliance.

repair.method: WORDS ARE NEVER USED for theta/tau/hexagon evaluation. theta~ := Ad(Delta), tau~ := Ad(delta) are built as GENUINE AUTOMORPHISMS of A:=Group(JX,JY,JC) via GroupHomomorphismByImages, using the closed-form identities (I4/I5 from scratchpad/math_f6false_admarking_v1.g, machine-confirmed on 150 windows by the mathematician): Ad(Delta)(x)=y,Ad(Delta)(y)=x,Ad(Delta)(c)=c ; Ad(delta)(x)=y,Ad(delta)(y)=y^-1 x^-1 c,Ad(delta)(c)=c. These identities hold IN PB3 ITSELF, hence in every quotient PB3/K automatically -- NO sigma1/sigma2 marking of the ROOF (M or K1) is needed at all, only of L (already computed, for c's L-block image). This ALSO eliminates the v2 BLOCKED-window case entirely: F6=false windows are now fully computable (confirmed empirically below, both on the small test set and on the true-largest window in item 8).
repair.predicate_formula: (i) f*theta~(f)=1  (ii) tau~^2(y^m f)*tau~(y^m f)*(y^m f)=c^m  (iii) <x^u,f^-1 y^u f>=G, all evaluated as group-element operations on p directly (p obtained via the SAME coset-construction as v2, never re-expressed as a word for predicate purposes)

item2_positive_control.interpretation: The naive (v1-style) word-level rule's verdict FLIPS (false->true) purely from appending an identity-evaluating relator to the word representative of the SAME group element -- reproducing exactly the falsifier's 600/600 reversal counterexample class on a real window in this repository, not a synthetic example. The repaired (F2) rule's result (false, for this specific candidate/m=0) is definitionally representative-independent: its computation path (group-element multiplication via theta~/tau~ automorphisms) never reads a word at any point, so there is no representative to vary. This is the mandated 'without this, mutants are empty' evidence.
